lines.6: 「Look! He's pretending to be an innocent bird that can't talk.」
lines.7: 「Let's fry him up and eat him after all.」
lines.8: 「All right, enough stupid talk. Time for class.」
lines.9: 「But you're the one who set all this up...」
lines.10: 「Adults are unfair! Everything they say is a lie!」
lines.11: 「My parents used to tell me Santa couldn't come because the roads were crowded! I never got a single present!」
lines.12: 「And my sister took it out on me by putting chili oil in my eye drops! Older sisters are scary, everyone. Watch out for sisters!」
lines.13: 「Aren't you drifting off-topic? And I think you're the only one with a sister that dangerous.」
lines.14: 「Come to think of it, Princess, you were quiet today.」
lines.15: 「Yeah. I noticed the camera from the beginning.」
lines.16: She said it as casually as anything.
